cph.editor.translation.provider.hint: Click to switch between LibreTranslate, DeepL, Google Cloud Translation and MyMemory.
Official libretranslate.com requires a purchased API key from its portal. A self-hosted LibreTranslate server can work without a key; enter its base address below. Click to open the official portal.

Create a DeepL API account and copy the key from API Keys. API Free includes 500,000 characters per month; its key ends in :fx and CoolPackHelper selects the Free endpoint automatically. Click to open the official setup guide.

Create a Google Cloud project, enable Cloud Translation API and billing, then create and restrict an API key to Cloud Translation. The first 500,000 NMT characters per month are covered by a free credit, but billing setup is still required. Click to open the official setup guide.

No account or key is required. MyMemory is a community translation memory, so quality can vary. Requests are limited to 500 bytes and are split automatically; text is sent in URL queries, so do not use it for sensitive content. Click to open its API documentation.
